title: BECE Basic Science - Basic Science - Science & Development
subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explain: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The method used to separate crude oil into its components is called:
questions.explain: Fractional distillation separates crude oil components based on their different boiling points.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of these is a product of crude oil refining?
questions.explain: Kerosene is a fuel obtained from the distillation of petroleum.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The force that pulls all objects towards the center of the Earth is:
questions.explain: Gravity is the force of attraction that Earth exerts on objects.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which heavenly body is a natural satellite of the Earth?
questions.explain: The Moon orbits the Earth and is its only natural satellite.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Scientific ethics implies that scientists should be:
questions.explain: Ethics in science demands honesty, integrity, and objectivity to ensure reliable and beneficial results.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of the negative application of science?
questions.explain: While nuclear energy has uses, the creation of weapons of mass destruction is considered a negative or harmful application of scientific knowledge.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: What is the center of the Solar System?
questions.explain: The Sun is the star at the center of the Solar System, around which planets orbit.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Crude oil is also known as:
questions.explain: Crude oil is often metaphorically called 'Black Gold' due to its high economic value and dark color.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Nigeria launched its first communication satellite, NIGCOMSAT-1, into space to improve:
questions.explain: NIGCOMSAT-1 was launched to enhance telecommunications, internet, and broadcasting services in Nigeria.
questions.subject: Basic Science
